notes.title: RELEASE DATE ANNOUNCED!
notes.notes:
We are very excited to announce that the official release date for Pedro's Adventures in Spanish has been confirmed! The game will become publicly available on July 29th, 2021 EST.

Thank you all for being so patient. We know a lot of you are excited to play as soon as possible, but we wanted to take the time to give the game the love and care it deserves and provide you with the best quality experience we could create. Many thousands of hours have gone into carefully crafting every aspect of the world, the characters, and the dialogue. 

To the many testers who have generously volunteered their time to play and provide thoughtful feedback, you have our eternal gratitude.

¡Mil gracias y hasta pronto! 

-Chaz and Andrea

notes.title: Final beta phase before release!
notes.notes:
¡Buenas noticias amigos! We are getting very close to release now and about to start the final beta testing phase. Don't worry if you missed out on play testing the game, the final version will be available for you in the next few weeks!

In alignment with the final beta phase a new early release version will be released over the next 24 hours. This version contains graphical polish along with tutorial improvements and improvements to some of the puzzle logic.

Apologies to anyone currently play testing, your current saved games will probably no longer work. But feel free to start a new game and continue your journey!

notes.title: New beta version and phase 2 testing
notes.notes:
Hey all! Thanks to some initial feedback we've made some major changes to the gameplay:

-Greatly increased Pedro's movement speed (including when he’s hungry or thirsty)
-The cursor will now become highlighted when hovered over an object that you can interact with 
-Improved performance of cut-scene videos
-Characters provide more clues for some of the harder puzzles
-Improved some artwork and animations
-Added pause button
-Improved tutorials
-Updated some dialogues for more closure on completed quests

Big thanks to the testers so far who have provided valuable feedback. Due to the scope of this update unfortunately your current saved games will no longer work. So you'll have to start a new game if you'd like to continue playing the beta release.

Phase 2 of the beta testing will begin shortly. And we are still on track for a mid July release. Mil gracias!
